about: Budgets of the Spinal Tap page (pages/spinal-tap-sparql.html) as a measured test, core issue 450. native: spinal_perf.ts, asserted by spinal_perf_test.ts in test.sh. hub: hub_spinal_perf.mjs (headless Chrome, the Hub). Each section has budgets ({max} or {min} on a dot path of the run's JSON) and known failures ({want_max} or {want_min} not met today, each with its issue). A budget may only tighten: spinal_perf_test.ts compares this file with the one on the merge base and fails when a max rises or a min falls, unless that entry carries a new 'accepted' text saying why (the cost is wanted). Times have a margin of about three times the measurement for slower CI runners; exact counters have none.

native.measured: 2026-11-15, Apple M1 (load average 11 to 13), macOS engine of main 3bf480d92 (build-3bf480d922cc-foafnaut-engine-darwin-arm64), 600 ticks of 16 ms; draw counts and the clip skip: engine d325ea8d4 of wip/spinal-draw (foafnaut-macos.yml branch build 43707008769)

layered.first_ms.what: first layered frame (layout and compile, checks off) of the page with its web font

layered.second_ms.what: a second layered frame of the unchanged page

layered.second_over_first.what: a second frame of an unchanged document with the same web font is markedly cheaper than the first (layered path)

probe.no_probe_ms.what: a whole-page frame with the layout kept and no CPU probe

probe.first_ms.what: a whole-page frame with the CPU probe (checks on); known slow, issue 450: may not get worse

tick.turn_ms.median.what: script turn of a tick (advance 16 ms)

tick.engine_ms.median.what: engine ms of a tick: turn and layered frame

tick.layouts.what: layouts in 600 ticks: the zoom's first transform and the report the page writes when the zoom ends (FrameCost.run_paints_never_layout: a run of paint-only frames lays out nothing after its first)

tick.whole_page_ticks.what: ticks that laid out or compiled every primitive again; every other tick takes the layered, paint-only path

tick.script_layouts.what: layouts the page's scripts forced by a layout read during the ticks

tick.recompiled_max.what: primitives compiled again by a paint-only tick (of about 2,850)

tick.changed_ticks.what: ticks in which the zoom changed the page: the animation ran

tick.late_over_early.what: frame ms late in the zoom over early in it: frames do not grow slower

rss_mb.growth_after_warmup.what: RSS growth from a quarter of the ticks to the end

heap_mb.growth.what: JS heap of the host over the ticks

tick.draw.segments_m.max.what: millions of path edges the scene shader walks to draw a tick's page layer (scene-work.mjs, four samples a pixel): the GPU cost of a frame, counted with no GPU. 2,853 before the shader skipped a clipped record's geometry (wip/spinal-draw, engine d325ea8d4)

tick.draw.outside_clip_m.max.what: edges of records in tiles wholly outside their clip: no longer walked by the shader, still listed in the tiles (Primitive.screenBox does not use clips)

probe.second_over_first.what: a second whole-page frame with the CPU probe of the unchanged document costs as much as the first (about 500 ms), although the layout is kept (frameWork.kept 1): the probe's work with the web font is done again each frame. Without the web font the probe frame is about 90 ms. When this meets want_max, spinal_perf_test.ts fails: move the entry to native with a max and update issue 450.

tick.draw.segments_m.max.what: per-tile edge lists would walk about 519 million at most on this page (tick.draw.binned_m, the same count with a tile walking only the edges that cross its rows and are not wholly left of it), flat across the zoom

hub.measured: 2026-11-15, Apple M1, headless Chrome 157 with WebGPU (adapter apple metal-3), 45 s; the published Hub (engine as deployed) and the same with this checkout's host files: both runs within the margins below; after takeTurn (wip/spinal-layers): 46 of 46 frames layered, layout median 35 ms, draw median 553 ms, max 3,480 ms (the draw follows the zoom's scale; see issue 450)

frames.count.what: frames the Hub drew of the page in 45 s

frames.layout_ms.median.what: engine layout ms of a frame

frames.draw_ms.median.what: draw ms of a frame (GPU adapter only; a fallback adapter is not measured against budgets)

errors.count.what: console errors and exceptions of the page and the engine worker

errors.device_lost.what: 1 when the GPU device was lost

rss_mb.peak.what: RSS of all of Chrome's processes

heap_mb.worker_end.what: JS heap of the engine worker at the end

frames.whole_page.what: animation frames on the whole-page path (stats.path frame). Since a script turn's frame asks for layers in every host (page-load.mjs takeTurn), the zoom's frames are layered: 46 of 46 on 2026-11-15, 0 before that change (46 of 46 on frame).

frames.layered.what: frames after the first on the layered path

draw_split.cpu_ms.median.what: CPU ms of the page layer draw to submit (plan, writes, commands)

draw_split.gpu_ms.max.what: GPU ms of the page layer draw until done (published engine, before the clip skip)

frames.draw_ms.median.what: a frame drawn in under 50 ms

frames.draw_ms.max.what: no frame over 1 s (a GPU command buffer of seconds risks the device)

draw_split.gpu_ms.max.what: GPU ms of the page layer draw: 1,848 with the published engine, 747 to 777 with the shader of wip/spinal-draw (tried on the Hub with that shader text): expected to flip when that engine is published
